walk :: proc() {
    for it := iter_make(&c); vo, _ in iterate(&it) {
        use(vo)
    }
}

main :: proc() {
    foo := #row_major matrix[4, 4]int{4 ..< 8 = 1, 1 ..< 2 = 2}
}
